summary: The test suite provides foundational coverage of core functionality but has significant gaps. Unit tests (version_bumper.bats) cover main functions like parse_version, determine_bump_type, compute_next_version, read/write_version, and generate_changelog—including both VERSION and package.json formats. Workflow structure tests (workflow_structure.bats) validate YAML parsing, triggers, job dependencies, and actionlint. However, integration tests (act_integration.bats) are shallow with only 3 cases and no error scenarios tested through act. Critical concerns: (1) Fixtures referenced in tests (commits-{patch,minor,major,none}.txt, package.json) are not provided, so fixture correctness cannot be verified; (2) Tests expect output like 'Bumped to: X.Y.Z' that doesn't appear in the provided implementation—likely in the missing workflow file; (3) Edge cases are minimally tested: parse_version has only 1 valid + 1 invalid case, no whitespace/empty file/malformed JSON testing, no permission/symlink errors, no breaking-change format variations; (4) act_integration doesn't test no-releasable-commits scenario through actual workflow. Test independence and setup/teardown are good, but overall rigor is weak for production confidence.
